name: Toyota Toyo Limiter v2 — BIN Inspection and Candidate Editing
description: Source-derived Toyota BIN inspection and candidate-only editing: change raw speed-limiter bytes, raw RPM limiter values, or apply the source-defined CUT OFF byte pattern. File identification must be unambiguous. Creates a separate candidate file; never overwrites input or flashes. Physical units and checksum correction are NOT verified. Independent validation is mandatory before any flash.

capabilities.description: Read Toyota ECU BIN metadata with source-derived profiles; return observed speed bytes, RPM and cut-off evidence, offsets, SHA-256 and uncertainty. Never patches or flashes.
List Toyo Limiter v2 calibration profile identifiers and expected BIN sizes from the authenticated source-derived profile manifest; no data is modified.
Generate a separate BIN candidate changing raw speed limiter byte(s), whole number 0..255, based on source patterns. Not a confirmed km/h value. Checksum not recalculated; NOT flash-ready.
Generate a separate BIN candidate changing raw RPM limiter 16-bit little-endian value, whole number 0..65535. Real RPM scaling unverified. Checksum not recalculated; NOT flash-ready.

Generate a separate BIN candidate applying the original CUT OFF pattern operation (pass cutoff=true) for supported profiles. Does not prove an exact RPM hard-cut strategy; checksum not recalculated; NOT flash-ready.

Generate a separate BIN candidate with any combination of raw speed (0..255), raw RPM (0..65535), or source-defined CUT OFF (cutoff=true). Supply at least one change. No fan-temperature change, checksum fix or flash. NOT flash-ready.
